# Second Breakfast Club -- self-test demo
qa = [
    ("What network aired Monty Python's Flying Circus?", "BBC"),
    ("How many episodes of Fawlty Towers were made?", "12"),
    ("Who plays David Brent?", "Ricky Gervais"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print("Q%d: %s" % (i, q))

print("Score: %d/%d" % (score, len(qa)))
